plans.idea: Faithful centered poster stack like the original: logo crowns the top axis, bottle is the large centrepiece, a wide text slot gives '30% OFF' near-original scale with 'SUNSET SALE' right under it, then a modest CTA and legal at the foot, all on one centre axis with even vertical gaps.

Headline-first offer layout: '30% OFF' and 'SUNSET SALE' lead at the top, the bottle fills the middle, and a footer row pairs the logo (left) with the CTA (right) on a shared baseline above the legal line, so the eye goes offer, then product, then brand and action.

Message block on top, product anchoring the bottom: logo, headline/subhead and CTA sit together as one tight centred group in the top third, and the bottle takes the lower half as a big grounded product shot above the legal line.
